handover_report.title: EverythingAI Phase 8.3 Closeout Candidate Handover
handover_report.status: closeout candidate - frontend hardening green, connector manual gates remain
handover_report.branch_policy: Work directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule.
handover_report.executive_summary: Phase 8.3 has advanced from general release-hardening into a closeout-candidate state. The frontend hardening, extracted-text preview consolidation, shared format utilities, admin explorer cleanup, status filter centralization, and Knowledge Base active citation highlighting are locally GREEN validated. The remaining true closeout blockers are controlled manual connector-specific setup/testing for installed Codex and Claude Code, plus final release checklist completion after those manual gates.

completed_phase_8_3_work.status: completed and green validated earlier in Phase 8.3B
completed_phase_8_3_work.summary: Admin provider settings support saved/replaced/cleared API key semantics while preserving masking and backend key-preservation behavior.

completed_phase_8_3_work.area: Extracted text formatting and preview reuse
completed_phase_8_3_work.summary: Client and Admin extracted text previews use shared preview selection, shared style, and a shared ExtractedTextPreview component. Formatting is preserved using pre-based rendering.
Shared formatter utilities, shared date formatting, shared file status filter options, and admin explorer cleanup were implemented with repeated local GREEN validation.
Knowledge Base article citations now keep active citation state visible across article rendering, source rail context, and source preview drawer interactions.

completed_phase_8_3_work.status: implemented in Admin Agent Connectors panel
completed_phase_8_3_work.summary: Admin-only connector panel includes Codex and Claude Code setup checklists, diagnostics progress snapshot, setup notes, guardrails, and chat-disabled readiness rules.
